declaredEventFamilies.zeroEventPolicy: emit every declared module:eventType identity with null inferential values

hypothesisFamily.null: mean paired event-minus-control difference equals zero
hypothesisFamily.familyBoundary: all testable identities in one timeframe evidence bundle
hypothesisFamily.retention: retain positive, negative, non-significant, insufficient-sample, and no-sample identities

nullBaseline.method: strict-prior exact-regime matched control without replacement within each focal module:eventType family
nullBaseline.focalEventExclusion: exclude control decision bars within plus-or-minus the maximum declared horizon of the same module:eventType family; unrelated technical events do not invalidate the focal-event null
nullBaseline.causality: control outcome through the maximum declared horizon must be finalized strictly before the event decision
nullBaseline.limitation: historical regime matching is descriptive and is not a randomized counterfactual

dependence.intervalMethod: moving block bootstrap over chronological event-order paired differences
dependence.nullPValue: two-sided centered moving-block bootstrap with add-one correction
assumptions: dependence is predominantly local in chronological event order
paired differences are sufficiently stationary within each module/event family for block resampling
event-order blocks are not equal-duration calendar-time blocks
long-memory, sparse-regime, and structural-break effects can invalidate nominal intervals and p-values

reported: paired standardized mean difference using sample standard deviation
effectSizes.zeroVariancePolicy: standardized effect is unavailable when paired-difference variance is zero

multipleTesting.passesDeclaredFdrGate: passesDeclaredFdr is true only when the Benjamini-Yekutieli adjusted q-value is at or below declaredQAlpha AND sampleDiagnostics.maximumGreedyNonOverlappingOutcomeWindows is at or above minimumNonOverlappingPairs; a tested hypothesis below the declared sufficiency floor keeps its rawPValue and adjustedQValue but reports passesDeclaredFdr false
multipleTesting.dependenceAssumption: valid under arbitrary dependence but conservative
multipleTesting.interpretation: diagnostic only; never a promotion, trading, prediction, or parameter-selection gate

stability.selection: all observed groups retained without minimum-sample or sign filter

reported: observations excluded to form the maximum greedy non-overlapping set
sufficientSample flag and the declared minimumNonOverlappingPairs floor it is evaluated against
